apis.name: activate_task_graph
apis.signature: activate_task_graph(conn, root_task_id: str, topology_generation: int, expected_digest: str) -> ActivatedGraphV1

rules: active/finalized member/link/topology rows are immutable
retry/remediation uses fresh root, task IDs and links
normal task lifecycle fields remain mutable

subscription event materialization reads the exact legacy cursor, registers deterministic immutable targets, inserts idempotent outbox rows with canonical event-payload SHA-256, and advances the cursor in one write transaction
a failed target or outbox identity/hash check rolls back all target, outbox and cursor writes; replay returns the original identities without duplicates
all transitions are CAS on outbox_id, state, lease_fence and lease_generation
OutboxClaimRequestV2 requires a non-empty unique eligible_target_ids selector; target-affine claims and returned batches contain only those targets and never fall back to the global queue
OutboxClaimRequestV1 and claim_outbox_batch retain their legacy global behavior for existing callers; new notifier code uses claim_outbox_batch_for_targets
outbox delivery envelope reads bind outbox_id to the expected target_id, controller authority, delivery target task and immutable task-event identity
attempt_no increments exactly once per failed lease; attempt_no >= max_attempts requires dead_letter
passive/wake/ack receipts are independent immutable hashes
dead_letter request/result both require and return reason_code, dead_letter_reason and reason_sha256
reclaim-to-retry request/result both require and return reason_code and reason_sha256; result also returns hold_receipt_sha256
reclaim requires a false owner_alive observation and an expired observed lease; passive/wake receipt hashes survive the retry transition
reason_sha256 is derived only from the exact canonical reason_hash_contract preimage before any CAS mutation
EventOutboxV4, API result and canonical hold receipt bind the same immutable reason_sha256
exact replay with the same reason_sha256 returns the same result and hold receipt; a different or non-derived reason_sha256 returns OUTBOX_REASON_HASH_CONFLICT without mutation

reason_hash_contract.serialization: compact JSON, object keys sorted, no terminal LF

dead_letter.derivation: reason_sha256 = SHA-256(canonical bytes of the exact-key object reconstructed from OutboxDeadLetterRequestV1)

reclaim_to_retry.derivation: reason_sha256 = SHA-256(canonical bytes of the exact-key object reconstructed from OutboxReclaimRequestV1)

reason_hash_contract.state_binding: EventOutboxV4.reason_sha256 equals the validated request hash and is immutable; retry_pending and dead_letter retain nonempty reason_code, and dead_letter also retains dead_letter_reason

hold_receipt_preimages.derivation: hold_receipt_sha256 = SHA-256(compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON of the selected exact-key object without terminal LF)

replay.same_hash: return the same state/result/hold receipt without mutation

event_consumption_and_finalization.canonical_preimage: compact UTF-8 sorted-key JSON without terminal LF; canonical_preimage_sha256 must hash the exact bytes
rules: same complete replay identity returns the same KanbanDecisionRefV1
same decision_id with any different identity field returns DECISION_IDENTITY_CONFLICT
any event owned by a different decision rejects the whole transaction as EVENT_BATCH_OVERLAP and inserts nothing
reserve CAS occurs before board run creation and CapacityRequestV2 contains no task_run_id
pre-run crash or board-run creation failure invokes cancel_capacity_reservation with exact reservation_id/board/task/token/fence
bind verifies exact reservation and board run/PID/claim fence before reserved-to-active CAS
renew and release CAS every lease/reservation/board/task/run/PID/token/fence field and return immutable receipt_sha256
reserved reconciliation and bound-lease reconciliation are separate APIs with exact identities and per-record receipts
unknown board/PID/identity evidence holds the slot; expiry alone never frees capacity
TaskScopeRequestV2 contains only task_id, task_run_id, operation, target_path and optional attachment_id; caller cannot supply roots, authority hashes, ancestors or policy toggles
authorize_task_path host-loads immutable TaskScopeAuthorityV1 by task_id/task_run_id before resolving target_path

TaskScopeAuthorityV1 authority_sha256 binds task_authority_sha256, workspace/artifact roots, approved input and attachment hashes, and ancestor_snapshot_sha256 using compact sorted UTF-8 JSON without terminal LF
missing/hash-mismatched host authority denies before filesystem access and before handler invocation
open each ancestor fd-relative with O_PATH|O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and compare device/inode/mode/uid/gid to the immutable host snapshot
write paths stay under host-loaded workspace/artifact roots; approved inputs/attachments are read-only
forged-root/ancestor fields are rejected by additionalProperties=false and cannot influence authorization
URI mode=ro
PRAGMA query_only=ON
total_changes=0
zero target write syscalls
future schema rejects before query

apis.name: validate_protocol
apis.signature: validate_protocol(contract_name: str, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Any

rules: reject duplicate JSON keys before schema validation
resolve only protocol-schemas-v5 definitions
additionalProperties=false is enforced at every closed object boundary
agent and Kanban lifecycle remain host-side
only terminal/code child enters pinned bwrap
clearenv, minimal binds and default-deny network; no weak fallback

apis.name: authorize_tool_dispatch
apis.signature: authorize_tool_dispatch(tool_name: str, args: Mapping[str, Any], task_scope: TaskScopeDecisionV1) -> Mapping[str, Any]

rules: all managed, legacy and plugin paths cross one final fail-closed boundary
reload swaps only a fully validated generation

x-public-contract-symbol-projection.selection: all signature-bearing entries under x-contracts[*].apis, x-contracts[*].api and x-contracts[*].host_authority_loader
x-public-contract-symbol-projection.canonicalization: compact UTF-8 sorted-key JSON array without terminal LF
